name: Iron door (grey-box prefab)
notes: The slice's locked exit (docs/design/vertical-slice.md B7, mw-e03.18): a hinged iron-bound door in the grey-box doorway, 8 cm thick. Iron, not wood, so it neither burns nor splinters: the key (or a thief's picks, or a sorcerer's spell) is the way through. Heavier than the wooden door: 1.5 s to swing open and a louder 55 dB groan. Shuts out light, smoke and sound while closed.
